conclusion: R234 preserves R217 metric definitions and thresholds and correctly withholds final GO/NO-GO without external Actions evidence, but the prepared verifier/checklist are not fail-closed on provenance/integrity. Seven concrete defects were identified; four fail-open predicates were confirmed by a small offline synthetic check. R220 remains authoritative and must close these gaps before causal interpretation.

r218_arm.compare_fact: arm head is one commit ahead and adds only research/R218_RUN_ARM.json

defects.defect: External Actions predicate accepts matching run_attempt values other than 1.
defects.impact: A rerun attempt can satisfy external_actions_same_job_provenance despite R217 one-job/no-retry policy and R218 arm attempt=1/attempts_allowed=1.

defects.defect: No cryptographic binding between artifact-dir and independently inspected Actions artifact/run; external schema omits artifact ID/name/digest and checkout head/workflow/executor blob proof.
defects.impact: A substituted local artifact can self-report the inspected run ID/attempt, while executor_commit is only a supplied JSON string.

defects.defect: Expected-panel file is not pinned to frozen blob/SHA in verifier.
defects.impact: A paired modified expected-panel and matching reports can redefine expected names/FLOPs while dataset/source hash/50-index gates still pass.

defects.defect: sha256.json completeness is not enforced; an empty manifest passes artifact_manifest.
defects.impact: Files consumed by verifier need not be manifest-covered, defeating the intended local integrity gate absent independent artifact digest binding.

defects.defect: Frozen prelaunch blob and exact required preflight gate names are not enforced; version evidence is partly trusted through owner booleans.
defects.impact: Incomplete or drifted preflight metadata can pass relevant predicates.

defects.defect: Per-block dataset path is not checked although pinned executor/checklist require dataset SHA/path.
defects.impact: Dataset path drift is not independently rejected by R234 verifier.

defects.defect: Mandatory telemetry files and worker-region evidence are not all required.
defects.impact: Missing /proc/taskset/worker-region instrumentation can coexist with artifact_contract_ok.

required_before_r220_causal_verdict: Bind artifact-dir to Actions artifact ID/name/digest and inspected run/job.
Verify Actions checkout head/arm ancestry and workflow/executor blobs at that head.
Pin exact expected-panel and prelaunch blobs/hashes.
Require manifest coverage for every consumed artifact file.
Require exact preflight gate-name set and stronger independent environment/version evidence.
Require dataset path/max_threads where schema exposes them and all mandatory telemetry.
